title.en: Record the order of room visits

brief.zh: 实现 depth_first_order(graph, start)。从栈顶取房间，把还没访问的邻居按列表顺序压入栈，最后返回各房间第一次被访问的顺序。
brief.en: Implement depth_first_order(graph, start). Pop a room from the stack, push its unvisited neighbors in list order, and return the order of first visits.

hints.zh: 列表里最后一个压入的邻居会先被取出。用 visited 字典阻止有环的路线重复访问。
hints.en: The last neighbor in the list is popped first. Use a visited dictionary to avoid revisiting rooms in cycles.

snippets.code:
if room in visited:
            continue
        visited[room] = True
        order.append(room)
